text: Brustor, the solar-shading and pergola maker producing in West Flanders, is a Belgian family business, founded in 1965 by Louis Brutsaert.
short: Brustor is a Belgian family business.

source.name: Brustor: 'About Brustor'
source.quote: Brustor is a Belgian family business that has become a top international player in the solar shading and pergola market over the years.
